relations.subject: Zuiho Yamaguchi
relations.evidence: He was an emeritus professor at the University of Tokyo, where he also took his doctorate degree in Sanskrit in 1954.

relations.subject: Zuiho Yamaguchi
relations.evidence: He graduated the First High school in 1950.

relations.subject: Zuiho Yamaguchi
relations.evidence: He entered University of Tokyo, and majored in Sanskrit and Indian philosophy. He entered the graduate school of the same university after his graduation in 1953.

relations.subject: Zuiho Yamaguchi
relations.evidence: He entered the graduate school of the same university after his graduation in 1953. He left the graduate school and went to France in 1956.

relations.subject: Zuiho Yamaguchi
relations.object: French National Centre for Scientific Research
relations.evidence: He left the graduate school and went to France in 1956. He started visiting in French National Centre for Scientific Research.

relations.subject: Zuiho Yamaguchi
relations.evidence: After 1962, he became a researcher supported by the Rockefeller Foundation and studied at l'École pratique des hautes études. He came back to Japan in 1964

relations.subject: Zuiho Yamaguchi
relations.evidence: He came back to Japan in 1964, and started working in Tōyō Bunko, Tokyo.

relations.subject: Zuiho Yamaguchi
relations.evidence: He became an assistant professor of University of Tokyo in 1970, and was promoted to professor in 1979.
